name: jump_pad
space: Blender coords: +Z up, front -Y, the floor is z = 0 with the origin under the pad's centre. glTF/Godot: (x, z, -y). The plate slides along its bone's local Y (metres, positive = up).

cutout_m.note: a plain box with square outside corners: it fills this cut-out exactly, its top flush with the floor

materials_note: map-generic finish in Tensor's materials (off-white and grey paint, matte black, stainless steel): no team colours
usage: a launch pad: play launch when a player steps on it and give them the jump impulse on the up-stroke (frames 0-4, the plate rising 15 cm); it holds, then comes down at half the speed. Re-trigger only once it is back down (frame 14).
